# Color Spray (`spells:color-spray`)
**Level 1 [Illusion](../magic-schools/illusion.md)** | **Casting Time:** Action | **Range:** Self
**Components:** V, S, M (a pinch of colorful sand) | **Duration:** Instantaneous | **Classes:** [Bard](../classes/bard.md), [Sorcerer](../classes/sorcerer.md), [Wizard](../classes/wizard.md)

You launch a dazzling array of flashing, colorful light. Each creature in a 15-foot Cone originating from you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Blinded condition until the end of your next turn.
